gates.detail: All schema versions and independent evaluation flag are valid
Every cue, representative frame, and overlapping shot is preserved
Carrier sweep covers the source and traces every discovered carrier
Every protocol field and action traces to the probe
Every capture action produced resolvable evidence
Inference provenance and reasoning are explicit
All unit ranges and frame references fit the source timeline
Channels, meaning changes, relationships, critical questions, and core evidence are accounted for
Internal meta-gate found no unchecked closure

examples.item: The one-minute headline is treated as an unproved author promise and directly opposed to the same-screen queue message saying the job will start in a few minutes.
The candidate separates visible input, prompt, queue, result, Gen-3 Alpha label, Extend/Lip Sync controls, and the absent execution bridges.
Non-speech audio is answered with bounded machine-listening evidence while result-clip audio remains correctly unknown.

All 19 audit-relevant core units have resolvable evidence: marketing promise, split-screen framing, claims, input, prompt, queue, result, missing workflow bridges, timing tension, provenance limits, export absence, CTA, status text, controls, result-audio boundary, and session authenticity.
The input/result visual match is preserved without upgrading edited juxtaposition into generation causality.
All 24 structured knowledge-unit statements either cite direct evidence, record author claims, or preserve bounded unknowns with explicit reasoning.
AudioSet labels are kept as machine-audition proposals; low-confidence whoosh, ding, keyboard and similar labels are rejected as literal events.

23 of 24 knowledge units have ranges and cited visual/audio evidence aligned with their stated intervals. KU-06 starts at 9.75 seconds but cites OCR-00139 at 9.20 seconds; the validator's 0.5-second tolerance ends at 9.25 seconds.
The queue tension is localized at 9.25 seconds; result controls at 13.35-15.25 seconds; result playback and CTA at 15.45-18.133 seconds.
Actual queue/generation/total time and same-session causality remain unknown despite the edited result reveal.
Plan, credits, region, settings, retries, export integrity, montage provenance, and third-party postprocessing remain unknown.
The post's music/effect behavior is bounded, but the embedded result file's own audio and Lip Sync state remain un-attributable rather than being labeled silent.
